Video3D · real-clip evidence


Targets: Laplacian ≥1.5× and SSIM +0.03; phone median and worst TT3D and bake must not regress. RSS is recorded for review, not an acceptance threshold. Strict full-cohort accounting and matching held-out evidence are required. High Laplacian can represent streaks or artifacts, so it does not establish visual quality alone.

Every declared case is retained. “No row” means absent from this captured snapshot, not a successful or explained outcome. Values are per-case observations; censored/error timings are not completed bake measurements.
